title: MPX EncounterPlus V5 Module
description: Configuration for an EncounterPlus V5 module project created with Module Packer Extended.

id.description: Required. Persistent UUID of the module. Keep this value unchanged between releases of the same module.
id.patternErrorMessage: The module id must be a valid UUID.

name.description: Required. Display name of the module.

slug.description: Required. Stable text identifier without accents or spaces. Separate words with hyphens.

acronym.description: Optional. Short name or acronym used to identify the module.

system.description: Required. EncounterPlus system ID, for example dnd5e.

category.description: Optional. Category used by EncounterPlus to classify the module: adventure, pack, rules, compendium, or other. Leave empty until a category is chosen.

author.description: Optional. Name of the module author or publisher.

shortDescr.description: Optional. Short description of the module.
examples: A short summary of the module.

descr.description: Optional. Full description of the module.
examples: A detailed description of the module and its contents.

tags.description: Optional. Array of keywords used to describe and find the module.

image.description: Optional. File name of the module cover image, relative to the project root.

banner.description: Optional. File name of the module banner image, relative to the project root.

website.description: Optional. Website URL for the module or its author.

repository.description: Optional. Source repository URL for the module.

package.description: Optional. Package or download URL for the module.
